title: Novel Substituted Spiro-Carbamates as MAGL Fluorescent, Raman, and PET Probes
abstract: Abstract                   This patent discloses spiro-carbamates as novel monoacylglycerol lipase (MAGL) probes for fluorescent, Raman, and PET imaging. It provides details on the novel spiro-carbamates and their potential use in the diagnosis of MAGL-related diseases.
